generate_protobuf_bindings: run python setup.py generate_protos to compile protobuf and gRPC bindings from storage.proto
build_bazel_extensions: run python setup.py build_ext to compile Bazel C++ extensions like episode_info and riegeli readers
install_envlogger_package: run pip install to install the envlogger package with all dependencies and Bazel extensions
build_python_package: run python setup.py build_py to build the Python package and auto-generate protobuf bindings
configure_bazel_extension: define a BazelExtension with a Bazel BUILD target path to register a C++ extension module
